facts: About 276,000 people (2013), in a valley 527 m up
On the Miljacka river, ringed by the Dinaric Alps
worth_knowing: The name comes from the Turkish saray, meaning palace. In 1914 the city saw the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, which sparked World War I.
